description: Reusable side-panel chrome: header (title + optional close) over a scrolling body, with an optional pinned footer. The container's width/borders/radius are left to the consumer via `className`. Used by ContentSidePanel and form panels.
example:
<SidePanel
  title="Request leave"
  onClose={() => undefined}
  footer={
    <>
      <Button>Submit</Button>
      <Button variant="secondary">Cancel</Button>
    </>
  }
>
  <Field label="Dates" htmlFor="dates">
    <Input id="dates" placeholder="DD.MM.YYYY - DD.MM.YYYY" />
  </Field>
</SidePanel>
